one_line: Speaking Coach: practice interviews, speeches and small talk out loud, with an AI partner, in 20 languages.
byline: By the Speaking Coach team at Sodhera Intelligence
footer_line: Speaking Coach is made by Sodhera Intelligence.

cta.heading: Say it out loud before it counts
cta.body: Speaking Coach gives you an AI partner who plays the other side, follows up on what you said, and shows you one thing to change. iPhone and Android, 20 languages.
cta.try_saying: In the app or in ChatGPT, try:
cta.default_prompt: Help me practice this out loud.
cta.app_store: Get it on the App Store
cta.chatgpt_english_only: The ChatGPT version works in English only.

tools.title: Free speaking tools
tools.intro: Check your pace, count your filler words, time a speech and find interview questions for your role. They run in your browser and need no sign-up.

interview-questions.title: Common interview questions and how to answer them
interview-questions.intro: What the interviewer is listening for, example answers for different levels of experience, the mistakes to avoid, and a way to practice each answer out loud.

interview-questions-by-role.title: Interview questions by job role
interview-questions-by-role.intro: The questions you are likely to hear for your role, what a clear answer does, and how to practice them before the day.

interviews.title: Interview types and how to prepare for each
interviews.intro: Phone screens, video calls, panels, case interviews and more: how each one works and how to get ready for it.

speeches.title: Speeches and toasts
speeches.intro: Structure, length, example lines and what to avoid for weddings, birthdays, farewells and other speeches people dread.

presentations.title: Presentations and pitches
presentations.intro: How to structure a talk, how long each part should run, and the questions your audience is likely to ask.

small-talk.title: Small talk and everyday conversations
small-talk.intro: Openers, follow-up questions and polite ways to leave, for the conversations that feel awkward: networking events, new jobs, parties and more.

guides.title: Speaking skills guides
guides.intro: Filler words, pace, pauses, nerves, storytelling and answer structures, explained plainly with something to practice.

compare.title: Speaking Coach compared
compare.intro: How Speaking Coach compares with other speaking and interview practice tools, and which one fits which need.

best.title: Best speaking and interview practice apps
best.intro: Honest lists by need. We make Speaking Coach, so we say where it fits and where another tool is the better choice.

glossary.title: Speaking and interview glossary
glossary.intro: Short, plain definitions of the terms you meet when preparing to speak, each with an example.

pages.title: About Speaking Coach
pages.intro: Who makes Speaking Coach and how it gives feedback.

tool.unsupported: Your browser can't turn speech into text. Paste your words below instead, or use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
tool.privacy: Your browser turns your speech into text. Chrome and Edge use Google's or Microsoft's speech service; Safari uses Apple's. Nothing is sent to Speaking Coach.
tool.pace_slow: On the slow side. Fine for a toast or a key point, but long stretches can lose people.
tool.pace_good: A comfortable pace for most listeners.
tool.pace_fast: On the fast side. Try a short pause after each main point.
tool.role_placeholder: Start typing a role, e.g. nurse
tool.role_none: No role found. Try a broader word, or browse all roles.
tool.next_step: Want feedback that quotes your words and a partner who talks back? Try Speaking Coach.
